paragraphs.text: Good afternoon, sisters and elders. There are no new updates today. I think we're just in a season where we're gonna just need to learn how to endure things cheerfully. As you remember from your school days, you needed to learn some things in each grade or you didn't get to advance to the next grade. Maybe God sometimes expects the same thing from his children. We see an example of this in the Book of Mormon, actually, when the good people of Alma are enslaved by the wicked priests of King Noah.

Let me read to you a few verses starting in verse 8 of Mosiah chapter 24. "And now it came to pass that Amulon begin to exercise authority over Alma and his brethren, and begin to persecute him, and cause that his children should persecute their children. For Amulon knew Alma, that he had been one of the king's priests, and that it was he that believed the words of Abinadi, and was driven out before the king; and therefore he was wroth with him, for he was subject to King Laman, yet he exercised authority over them, and put tasks upon them, and put taskmasters over them. And it came to pass that so great were their afflictions that they begin to cry mightily to God. And Amulon commanded them that they should stop their cries; and he put guards over them to watch them, that whosoever should be found calling upon God should be put to death. And Alma and his people did not raise their voices to the Lord their God, but did pour out their hearts to him; and he did know the thoughts of their hearts."

"And it came to pass that the voice of the Lord came to them in their afflictions, saying: Lift up your heads and be of good comfort, for I know of the covenant which ye have made unto me; and I will covenant with my people and deliver them out of bondage. And I will also ease the burdens which are put upon your shoulders, that even you cannot feel them upon your backs, even while you are in bondage; and this will I do that ye may stand as witnesses for me hereafter, and that ye may know of a surety that I, the Lord God, do visit my people in their afflictions. And now it came to pass that the burdens which were laid upon Alma and his brethren were made light; yea, the Lord did strengthen them that they could bear up their burdens with ease, and they did submit cheerfully and with patience to all the will of the Lord. And it came to pass that so great was their faith and their patience that the voice of the Lord came unto them again, saying: Be of good comfort, for on the morrow I will deliver you out of bondage. And he said unto Alma: Thou shalt go before this people, and I will go with thee and deliver this people out of bondage."

So you can see elders and sisters that the Lord didn't free these people right away. He could have but he didn't. I think he wanted them to learn how as the scripture says to submit cheerfully and with patience to all the will of the Lord. I don't know if this is what we all need to learn but it is certainly always a good thing to learn and to do. So we get to have the exercise right now and doing it and if we are smart we will.

Okay in our discussion of the five steps process for achieving big and important goals and also for avoiding being distracted by lesser things we have come to step four which is design a plan that will help you solve the problem by removing the root causes.

As you recall the five steps are: number one, set big goals that are important to you; step two, identify and don't tolerate the problems that stand in your way of achieving those goals; three, accurately diagnose the problems to discover the root causes; four, design a plan that will help you to solve the problem by removing the root causes; and then five, do what's necessary to push these designs through to productive results.

Tomorrow we'll finish up with step five and a few other key elements but today I want to help you understand how important it is to know how to design solutions to problems. You can't just wish your problems away and you can't run away from them. They are a part of you and your goals and they stand between you and your goals and the only way to get the life you want is to design a solution to every weakness and problem that you encounter on your path to the goals you desire. Many of those weaknesses and problems will be inside of you and so wherever you go they're going with you until you get rid of them, overcome them, find ways to work around them.

So this step, step four has several phases to it like all the others. Phase one is to go back before you go forward. This means you need to replay the story of where you've been or what you've done that led up to where you are right now and then visualize what you and others must do in the future so you can reach your goals. It's kind of like going back and looking at the video of the game you just played or the performance you just gave. By going back you see things in perspective. You see your problem of course but you also see the things you did right and then you visualize how it could have been done differently. Visualization is a very important part of design. First you have to see it then you can begin to do it.

Remember that there are typically many paths to achieving your goals. You only need to really find one that works for you. Think of your plan as being like a movie script in that you visualize who will do what through a timeline. Think of someone smarter stronger and better than you and then imagine in your mind how he or she would do what you're trying to do. In other words if you were having a problem with your companion you might ask the WWJD question and then visualize what Jesus would do if he were in your situation.

Write down your plan and share it with a trusted friend. Ask that friend to help you do this goal and to help by measuring your progress against your plan. In other words to help provide support and also to help hold you accountable. Recognize that it doesn't take a lot of time to design a good plan. A plan can be sketched out and refined in just an hour or two. It could spread out over days or weeks if it's really complicated but many of the problems that we encounter in our goals are problems that the root causes can be solved with a plan pretty quickly. The process however is still essential because it determines what you will have to do to be effective.

Obtaining clarity in your design is absolutely essential. Too many people make the mistake of spending virtually no time on designing because they're so anxious to get started with doing. But designing always comes before doing. At least it comes before doing something that's done in a very very good way and leads to a productive result.

So there you have it. Step 4. Tomorrow we'll conclude this topic and I will think of something new for us to consider for next week. I love you, I'm proud of you. And what are we all going to learn today and throughout this quarantine? Yes, we're going to learn how to submit cheerfully and with patience to all the will of the Lord. Good night and God bless you.
